SMAA_GLSL_3 / SMAA_GLSL_4 porting macros), LICENSE.txt, README.md, and the
precomputed lookup textures Textures/AreaTex.h and Textures/SearchTex.h
(generated by the upstream Scripts/AreaTex.py and SearchTex.py).
Left out: Demo/, Scripts/ and the DDS copies of the textures.
